# checkmk_folder (Data Source)

Use this data source to retrieve information about a CheckMK folder.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    checkmk = {
      source = "N3moAhead/checkmk"
    }
  }
}

provider "checkmk" {
  url      = "http://localhost:5000/test"
  username = "automation"
  password = "your-secret-here"
}

# Look up a folder by path
data "checkmk_folder" "example" {
  path = "~production"
}

output "folder_title" {
  value = data.checkmk_folder.example.title
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `path` (String) The path to the folder (e.g., '/', '/production', '/production/web').

### Read-Only

- `attributes` (Map of String) Folder attributes that are inherited by hosts in this folder.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier for the folder (same as path).
- `title` (String) Human-readable title for the folder.
